R._noteR_order: HIT ORDER (Cowork 2026-07-16 hit-order audit): the %CURRENT-hp hit is ordered FIRST, before flat TotalDamage. R (Crescent Guard) is one instantaneous cast (flat base + % of target CURRENT hp), so the %current must read the PRE-cast current HP. The engine re-evaluates a Current-HP hit against RUNNING HP, so flat-first UNDER-counts the %current term (flat already lowered current). Flat is HP-independent, inert when second. Same class as the %missing cases (Kindred E / Belveth R / RekSai R), opposite sign.
